status_summary: H.R. 421, the Small Business Regulatory Flexibility Improvements Act, introduced 2025-01-15 and referred to the House Judiciary, Small Business and Oversight committees, would replace the panel provisions of 5 U.S.C. 609 so that any agency, not only the currently covered agencies, must notify the Chief Counsel for Advocacy before proposing a rule with a significant small business impact, and it adds judicial review and a first-time paperwork fine waiver. A Senate bill of the same name, S. 5178, was introduced 2026-07-30 and referred to the Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee. No 119th Congress bill titled the IMPROVE the SBA Act and no Administration statement supporting either measure was found.

timeline.event: H.R. 421, the Small Business Regulatory Flexibility Improvements Act, was introduced; it would extend the pre-proposal panel process under 5 U.S.C. 609 to agencies generally.
S. 5178, the Small Business Regulatory Flexibility Improvements Act, was introduced and referred to the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee.
